==Description==
'''Graveyard''' was an island [[Maps|map]] centered around a graveyard theme.

==Design & Path==
'''Graveyard''' took place, on a graveyard island. The entire island was surrounded by green acid, which suggested the whole island was toxic. Indeed, there appeared to be a radioactive river running through the map leading to an acid bath. As one would expect, various memorials and gravestones could be seen. Various fences and dead trees could also be seen. This map was also quite hilly, with many cliff spots.

The grey pebble path started at a graveyard and ended at a cave. The path initially circled around a rock before cutting back on itself to reach the cave.

==Strategy==
*Since this map has many cliff spots, the [[Ranger|Outlaw]] and [[Mortar]] are recommended here.
*Be aware of the lack of ground space near the path on this map.
**Sell towers when better towers can take their spot.
**As this map is quite short, the [[Pyromancer]], [[Freezer]] and [[Electroshocker]] can be used to slow down enemies from reaching the end.

==Trivia==
*This map was released when the [[Halloween 2019 Event]] was active, though it was not an event map.
